notablePrerequisites: You are able to pay to cast Spider-Man 2099 using any combination of mana-producing creatures and/or creatures that can reduce its cost using convoke.
description:
Cast Spider-Man 2099 by paying its mana cost reduced by the number of creatures you can tap while casting it.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Spider-Man 2099 trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
